idp.description: This schema defines defines the identity provider config.

entityId.description: Identity Provider Entity ID usually same as the SSO login URL.

idpX509Certificate.description: IdP signing certificate(s): a PEM certificate or concatenated PEM bundle; a single base64 DER certificate is also accepted. Saving requires at least one currently valid certificate. At runtime every configured certificate is trusted, including expired and future rollover ones, so remove a retired key explicitly.

nameId.description: Name ID format for SAML assertions

sp.description: This schema defines defines the identity provider config.

spPrivateKey.description: Sp Private Key for Signing and Encryption Only

callback.description: Service Provider Entity ID usually same as the SSO login URL.

security.description: This schema defines defines the security config for SAML.

strictMode.description: Enable strict SAML protocol checks and the Want Messages Signed / Want Assertions Signed policies. Require Encrypted Assertions applies independently of strict mode.

validateXml.description: In case of strict mode whether to validate XML format.

tokenValidity.description: Lifetime in seconds of the OpenMetadata JWT issued after SAML authentication.

sendEncryptedNameId.description: Encrypt Name Id while sending requests from SP.

sendSignedAuthRequest.description: Sign the Authn Request while sending.

signSpMetadata.description: Want the Metadata of this SP to be signed.

wantMessagesSigned.description: SP requires the messages received to be signed.

wantAssertionsSigned.description: SP requires the assertions received to be signed.

wantAssertionEncrypted.description: Reject plaintext assertions even when Strict Mode is off. Optional and disabled by default. Requires an SP private key and matching certificate; configure token encryption at the IdP too. Providing an SP key alone does not require encryption.

debugMode.description: Get logs from the Library in debug mode

samlDisplayNameAttributes.description: Ordered list of SAML attribute names to check for display name. First available attribute wins. Defaults to common OIDC/SAML attribute names.
